PR (cited in the notes as #1): Add database controllers and types (Amazon RDS, Google Cloud SQL) [closed]
This PR adds controllers and types for the cloud database resources of Amazon RDS and Google Cloud SQL. The necessary project scaffolding generated by kubebuilder is also included.

Note that these controllers are early prototypes, full reliability and robustness is not included. This is just to get a start on the patterns for managing cloud resources in Kubernetes.

The commits are split up into a few functional areas for easier review.
